notes: Discontinued consumer WiFi internet radio (Bravado-X); no live manufacturer spec page exists on gracedigital.com (checked product-manuals page, not listed). Used the official Grace Digital user manual hosted on ManualsLib (rear-panel diagram page 7, specifications page 40) as the most authoritative available source. Power spec from manual: Mains AC 100-240V 50/60Hz on external adapter, 12V 1.5A DC into unit, 18W consumption. Speaker Out is bare-wire terminal block (6-8ohm), not a true banana-plug jack - "banana" chosen as closest connector id in the allowed list. No native RJ45 Ethernet port; wired LAN only via an optional USB-Ethernet dongle through the USB-A port, so no standalone rj45 port was listed. Could not confirm a dedicated FM antenna jack on this exact rear panel (device is primarily WiFi-based; earlier confusable sibling model GDI-IRD4400M has similar naming). No bandwidth grades apply - all ports are analog audio, DC power, or USB (no USB speed stated in manual, so grade omitted).
